TOPIC10.12
Lagrange Error Bound
LEARNINGOBJECTIVE
LIM-8.C
Determine the error bound
associated with a Taylor
polynomial approximation. bc
only
ESSENTIALKNOWLEDGE
LIM-8.C.1
The Lagrange error bound can be used to
determine a maximum interval for the error of a
Taylor polynomial approximation to a function.
bc only
LIM-8.C.2
In some situations, the alternating series error
bound can be used to bound the error of a
Taylor polynomial approximation to the value of
a function. bc only
ENDURINGUNDERSTANDING
LIM-8
Power series allow us to represent associated functions on an appropriate interval.
